operations.label: cDNA synthesis and amplification
operations.description: Within the broad depicted block, reverse-transcribe mRNA in the collected droplets, incorporating barcode primers into cDNA. The primary implementation then breaks the emulsion, ligates an adapter to cDNA and amplifies the combined DNA to produce the sequencing library.

method_scopes.rationale: All six operations apply to the RNA-seq implementation of Hi-SCL depicted here. The assigned card title, matching collection heading and caption identify one target, Hi-SCL (High-Throughput Single-Cell Labeling). This is an alias expansion, not a second method. The primary Hi-SCL paper directly supports barcode-droplet preparation, cell lysis in droplets, merger with RT reagent addition, in-drop RT and subsequent pooled DNA amplification. Similar methods, associated commercial kits and hypothetical applications in surrounding prose do not add target workflows.
